items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records are absent or incomplete; and experiments lack defined incremental costs and learning outcomes. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation. Minimum measurement: one identical reporting window reconciling attributable revenue, attribution, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and experiment learning-outcome records. Treat impressions, clicks, rankings, CTR targets, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, and AI usage as prioritization or operating metrics—not financial returns.
